sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, INV_NO, STATUS, SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER IN ( SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTAL2') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM <= 30 AND LEGACY_IV_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY BUYER, INV_NO, STATUS

SELECT MAX(A.SEQ) AS IF_NUMBER , MAX(A.STATUS) AS STATUS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME , MAX(A.LEGACY_IV_NO) AS LEGACY_IV_NO , MAX(A.INV_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE , MAX(TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS ADD_DATE , MAX(TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'HH24MISS')) AS ADD_TIME FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.STATUS = #STATUS# AND A.SEQ = #SEQ# AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.INV_DATE, A.STATUS

SELECT A.LEGACY_IV_NO AS LEGACY_IV_NO , A.LEGACY_IV_SEQ AS LEGACY_IV_SEQ , A.STATUS AS STATUS , A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.PLANT AS PLANT , A.ATTR_02 AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , A.ITEM_QTY AS INV_QTY , A.ATTR_01 AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.STATUS = #STATUS# AND A.SEQ = #SEQ# AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_IV_NO, LEGACY_IV_SEQ, STATUS
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND SEQ = #SEQ# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND STATUS = #STATUS#
